proposal.reason: Primary change is review-routing behavior in workflow automation: .github/workflows/review-routing.yml switches invitation input to fromJSON(needs.classify.outputs.recommendation).pr_number, fixing reusable-workflow handoff/type correctness for PR-number routing. Supporting but still same module scope is .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py, which changes GitHubError/request diagnostics (bounded message/errors extraction, redaction, truncation) for reviewer-invitation API failures; this is review/assignment workflow policy tooling, not CI/build/runtime logic.
